title: KAFKA-17029: SetSchemaMetadata throws DataException for non-STRUCT schemas
body:
SetSchemaMetadata#apply unconditionally calls Schema#fields(), which throws a DataException for any schema that is not a STRUCT. Consequently the SMT fails on Avro/Connect primitive schemas (and also on array and map schemas), even though setting only the schema name/version does not require struct fields.

This change copies the fields only when the schema type is STRUCT, mirroring the existing handling of keySchema/valueSchema for map and array types.

### Testing
- ./gradlew :connect:transforms:test --tests "org.apache.kafka.connect.transforms.SetSchemaMetadataTest" (added coverage for primitive, primitive with null value, array and map schemas)
- ./gradlew :connect:transforms:spotlessCheck :connect:transforms:checkstyleMain :connect:transforms:checkstyleTest
